title: Color Access Dashboard
summary: A dashboard that adds a high-contrast color palette toggle.
intended_users: Dashboard users who prefer higher contrast.

design_decisions.alternatives_considered: No user research or non-visual representation was considered.
design_decisions.accepted_trade_off: The implementation changes only color and does not address semantics, keyboard operation, reflow, or assistive technology.
design_decisions.validation_approach: The author visually inspected one desktop screenshot.
design_decisions.reconsideration_conditions: Reconsider if there is more time.

testing_strategy: No automated or assistive-technology testing exists.
security_threat: No security or safety threat analysis was performed. None documented. Residual risk: All relevant threats and misuse cases are unknown.
production_limitation: Canvas charts have no text alternative, controls are pointer-only, and mobile reflow is unknown.
technical_debt: Define target access needs and rebuild the dashboard with semantic data tables, keyboard controls, focus management, and user testing.
track_alignment_explanation: The project claims inclusive technology based only on an alternate palette; it does not demonstrate a defined disability need or accessibility-centered product mechanism.

ai_disclosure.purposes: Codex was used to author this deliberately synthetic calibration fixture and its structured submission answers.
ai_disclosure.substantially_generated_areas: All fixture source, documentation, tests, and submission narratives are synthetic and AI-assisted.
ai_disclosure.review_validation: The calibration operator reviews files for intended evidence strength, consistency, and absence of real secrets before pinning the commit.
ai_disclosure.rejected_or_changed_suggestion: Generic claims of runtime correctness were rejected because Finch performs static evidence review only.

ai_disclosure_narrative: This entire project is synthetic AI-assisted test data. It represents no participant, deployed product, or real credential.
